This appeal coming on for admission this day, the court  following:
 ORDER Heard on I.A. No.7898/2018, an application under Section 5 of Limitation Act.
2. The appeal was filed with delay of 139 days.

3. It is submitted by the counsel for the appellant that since the appellant had suffered fracture and he could not arrange the amount for payment of Court fee as the insurance company had not deposited the Award amount, therefore, there is delay in filing the appeal.
4. The prayer for condonation of delay is vehemently opposed by the counsel for the respondents.
5. For the reasons mentioned in the application, the same is allowed.
The delay in filing the appeal is hereby condoned.

6. This Miscellaneous Appeal under Section 173 of Motor Vehicles Act has been filed against the Award dated 25/10/2017 passed by First Additional Member to the Court of First Additional Member, Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Chhindwara (M.P.) in Claim Case No.200028/2016.
7.

sentences.text: Since the factum of accident is not in dispute, therefore it is sufficient to mention that the appellant was the driver of offending Scooter bearing registration No. M.P. 28/ SB - 5990, whereas the respondent No.1 - Rajesh Batti was the driver of the offending motorcycle bearing registration No. M.P. 28/ ML-5908.
Both the vehicles collided with each other on 10/06/2015 resulting in injuries to the appellant as well as to the respondent No.1.

The respondent No.1 has filed the Claim Case No.200026/16, whereas the appellant filed the Claim Case No.200028/16.
8.

9. The Claims Tribunal has computed the compensation as Rs.1,10,000/-.
After deducting 50% of the same, an amount of Rs.55,000/- has been awarded to the appellant.
10. Challenging the Award passed by the Claims Tribunal, it is submitted by the counsel for the appellant that the compensation has been awarded on a lower side.
11. Per contra, the counsel for the respondents supported the compensation amount awarded by the Claims Tribunal.

12. Considering the submissions made by the counsel for the parties, this Court is of the considered opinion that the appellant is entitled for the following compensation amount:-
